name: yepwatch-e2e-native
description: Android E2E harness for YepWatch. Kept out of yepwatch-app/package.json: its scripts are part of the Expo runtime fingerprint (docs/ota-updates.md). Uses yepwatch-app's node_modules (Playwright, Expo CLI).

scripts.e2e:native:apk: node -e "import('./lib/build.mjs').then(async b => { const { resolveStack } = await import('./lib/stack.mjs'); console.log(await b.ensureApk(resolveStack())); })"
